name: carcassonne-tournament-manager
description: Aplicación de gestión de torneos presenciales de Carcassonne Colombia

scripts.dev: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:store: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_STORE_MODE=true npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:react:store" "npm run dev:electron:store"
scripts.dev:hq: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_HQ_MODE=true npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:react:hq" "npm run dev:electron:hq"
scripts.dev:int: cross-env APP_ENV=international npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:react:int" "npm run dev:electron:int"
scripts.build: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia npm run build:react && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia npm run build:electron
scripts.build:int: cross-env APP_ENV=international npm run build:react:int && cross-env APP_ENV=international npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia electron-builder
scripts.dist:int: npm run build:int && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=international electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:store: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_STORE_MODE=true npm run build:react:store && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_STORE_MODE=true npm run build:electron && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:hq: cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_HQ_MODE=true npm run build:react:hq && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia DEVIR_HQ_MODE=true npm run build:electron && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=colombia electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:int: npm run build:int && npm run rebuild-sqlite && cross-env APP_ENV=international electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild-sqlite && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run rebuild-sqlite && electron-builder --linux
scripts.db:check: npm run db:audit && npm run db:validate
